topic_ko: 지루함에서 경탄으로 — Cloud Monorail 위의 심경 변화
_note: 심경변화(narrative story) FULL set. grammar/vocab/order/insert/summary/writing 작성. 억지 학술유형(주제/주장/빈칸) 제외. 유형마다 passage를 다르게 패러프레이즈.

passage: Mark's friends had invited him to Sky National Park to ride the Cloud Monorail, which went to the top of the mountain.
Mark didn't feel like going, but he went because he had nothing better to do.
He checked his watch as the monorail departed and then blankly looked out the window.
Clouds surrounded the monorail, so all he saw was grey for what felt like forever.
Just as he started feeling sleepy, the monorail rose above the clouds.
He opened his mouth as he saw the most beautiful mountains to spread out before him all the way to the ocean.
He couldn't believe how marvelous nature could be and wondered what he would have missed if he hadn't come.
grammar.explanation_ko: ④ 지각동사 saw의 목적격보어 자리에는 현재분사(spreading out) 또는 동사원형(spread out)이 와야 한다. to부정사(to spread out)는 지각동사 목적격보어 자리에 사용할 수 없으므로 spreading out으로 고쳐야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①주격 관계대명사 which + went, ②feel like + -ing, ③관계대명사 what이 이끄는 명사절(what felt like forever), ⑤가정법 과거완료 would have missed는 모두 어법상 옳다.

passage: Mark's friends had invited him to Sky National Park to ride the Cloud Monorail, which went to the top of the mountain.
Mark didn't feel like going, but he went because he had nothing better to do.
He checked his watch as the monorail departed and then attentively looked out the window.
Clouds surrounded the monorail, so all he saw was grey for what felt like forever.
Just as he started feeling sleepy, the monorail rose above the clouds.
He opened his mouth as he saw the most beautiful mountains spreading out before him all the way to the ocean.
He couldn't believe how marvelous nature could be and wondered what he would have missed if he hadn't come.
vocab.explanation_ko: ② Mark는 할 일도 없이 마지못해 탑승해 무관심하게 창밖을 봤다. '주의 깊게(attentively)'는 관심·집중을 의미하므로 무관심·지루함을 나타내는 문맥과 정반대이다. blankly(멍하니)로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①nothing better to do(달리 할 일이 없는), ③surrounded(둘러쌌다), ④spreading out(펼쳐지는), ⑤marvelous(경이로운)는 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

order.given: Mark's friends had invited him to Sky National Park to ride the Cloud Monorail, which went to the top of the mountain. Mark didn't feel like going, but he went because he had nothing better to do.

blocks.A: Just as he started feeling sleepy, the monorail rose above the clouds. He opened his mouth as he saw the most beautiful mountains spreading out before him all the way to the ocean.
blocks.B: He checked his watch as the monorail departed and then blankly looked out the window. Clouds surrounded the monorail, so all he saw was grey for what felt like forever.
blocks.C: He couldn't believe how marvelous nature could be and wondered what he would have missed if he hadn't come.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글(마지못한 탑승) 뒤에, (B)에서 지루하게 시계를 보며 회색 구름만 본 경험(bored 심경 전개), (A)에서 졸다가 구름 위로 솟아 경이로운 광경을 목격하는 전환점, (C)에서 경탄과 후회 섞인 감동으로 마무리되는 순서가 자연스럽다. (B)-(A)-(C) = ③.
order.distractor_ko: (A)는 전환점이므로 (B)의 지루한 전개 뒤에 와야 하고, (C)의 결론 경탄은 반드시 전환점(A) 이후에 온다. (A)-(B) 순서는 전환이 먼저 오고 전개가 뒤에 오므로 불자연스럽다.

insert.insert_sentence: Just as he started feeling sleepy, the monorail rose above the clouds.

passage_marked.text: Mark didn't feel like going, but he went because he had nothing better to do.
He checked his watch as the monorail departed and then blankly looked out the window.
Clouds surrounded the monorail, so all he saw was grey for what felt like forever.
He opened his mouth as he saw the most beautiful mountains spreading out before him all the way to the ocean.
He couldn't believe how marvelous nature could be and wondered what he would have missed if he hadn't come.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장(졸음이 오던 순간 구름 위로 솟아오름)은 지루함(bored) 단계의 마지막 장면 뒤, 그리고 경탄(amazed)의 첫 장면('입을 벌렸다') 바로 앞에 위치해야 심경 전환이 자연스럽다. ③ 위치가 '회색만 보이던 지루함(③ 앞 문장)' 뒤이자 '아름다운 산이 펼쳐지는 장면(④ 위치 문장)' 바로 앞이다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①② 뒤에 오면 아직 지루함 전개가 끝나지 않아 전환이 너무 이르고, ④⑤ 뒤에 오면 이미 경이로운 장면이 묘사된 뒤에 전환 문장이 오는 역순이 된다.

passage: Mark's friends invited him to Sky National Park to ride the Cloud Monorail to the mountaintop.
He had no desire to go but came along because he had nothing better to do.
He checked his watch and stared blankly out the window as the monorail departed.
Clouds surrounded the car, leaving nothing to see but grey for what seemed like a very long time.
Just when he was about to fall asleep, the monorail climbed above the clouds.
He was struck speechless by the sight of the most beautiful mountains stretching all the way to the ocean.
He was overwhelmed by how wonderful nature could be and felt sure he would have deeply regretted not coming.
summary.summary_template: Having joined the trip out of __(A)__, Mark was utterly __(B)__ when the monorail rose above the clouds to reveal a breathtaking view of mountains and ocean.
summary.explanation_ko: (A) Mark는 '딱히 할 일이 없어(nothing better to do)' 갔으므로 지루함(boredom)에서 비롯된 참가였다. (B) 구름 위 절경을 보고 '입을 벌리고 경이로움을 믿을 수 없었던' 반응은 경탄(astonished)이다. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 curiosity(호기심)/excitement(흥분)/anxiety(불안)가 아닌 boredom(지루함), (B)는 disappointed(실망)/relieved(안도)가 아닌 astonished(경탄)여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그는 모노레일이 출발할 때 시계를 확인하고는 멍하니 창밖을 내다봤다.
writing.answer: He checked his watch as the monorail departed and then blankly looked out the window.
writing.explanation_ko: 시간부사절 as the monorail departed, 부사 blankly가 looked out을 수식. looked out the window = '창밖을 내다봤다'.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 막 잠이 들려고 하던 순간, 모노레일이 구름 위로 솟아올랐다.
writing.answer: Just as he started feeling sleepy, the monorail rose above the clouds.
writing.explanation_ko: Just as + S + V(= '바로 ~하던 순간'), start + -ing(= '~하기 시작하다'), rose(rise의 과거).

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그는 가장 아름다운 산들이 바다까지 눈앞으로 펼쳐지는 것을 보며 입을 벌렸다.
conditions: 지각동사 saw + 목적어 + 현재분사 구조를 사용할 것
all the way to the ocean을 포함할 것
writing.answer: He opened his mouth as he saw the most beautiful mountains spreading out before him all the way to the ocean.
writing.explanation_ko: 지각동사 saw + 목적어(mountains) + 현재분사(spreading out), 관용 표현 opened his mouth(입을 벌리다 = 경탄), all the way to the ocean(바다까지 멀리).

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: He couldn't believe how marvelous nature could be and wondered what he would have missed if he hadn't come.
writing.answer: 그는 자연이 얼마나 경이로울 수 있는지 믿을 수 없었고, 만약 오지 않았다면 무엇을 놓쳤을지 궁금해했다.
writing.explanation_ko: couldn't believe how + 형용사 + S + V(간접의문문), wondered + what절(목적어), would have missed if he hadn't come(가정법 과거완료 — 과거 사실 반대 가정).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Mark joined the trip out of (A)___________, not enthusiasm, but when the monorail soared above the clouds, he was completely (B)___________ by the stunning view.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 'nothing better to do'에서 알 수 있듯 지루함(boredom)이 동기였고, (B) 'couldn't believe how marvelous', 'opened his mouth' 등 경탄(amazed) 심경의 핵심 어휘로 수렴된다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: Mark는 가고 싶지 않았지만, 딱히 더 나은 할 일이 없었기 때문에 갔다.
conditions: didn't feel like + -ing 구문을 사용할 것
nothing better to do를 포함할 것
writing.answer: Mark didn't feel like going, but he went because he had nothing better to do.
writing.explanation_ko: feel like + 동명사(going), 역접 but, 이유 부사절 because + 주어 + had nothing better to do.
